heroHeadline: IDF Kills Nukhba Force Deputy Commander Linked to Oct 7 Hostage Abductions; Netanyahu-Trump Call Tense Over Planned Beirut Strike
heroSubtitle: On June 2, 2026, the IDF announced the killing of Youssef Ayesh Awad Ramadan — a Nukhba Force deputy commander who participated in the October 7, 2023 abduction of hostages Hersh Goldberg-Polin, Alon Ohel, Eliya Cohen, and Or Levy from the Re'im bomb shelter — along with four other Hamas/PIJ operatives including another Nukhba Force team commander and a PIJ sniper platoon chief. Separately, Israeli strikes killed at least 3 Palestinians in Deir al-Balah, Zawayda, and Khan Younis. Netanyahu held a tense call with Trump, who urged Israel to hold a planned strike on Hezbollah targets in Beirut ('Trump tells Netanyahu: Don't'); Israel agreed to defer provided it was not attacked first. Netanyahu welcomed new Mossad chief Roman Gofman, vowing to hasten the fall of Iran's regime. A fresh round of Israel-Lebanon talks opened in Washington on June 2. Ultra-Orthodox coalition parties UTJ and Shas threatened to withhold support unless the Torah Study Basic Law was fast-tracked in the Knesset, deepening coalition instability. The cumulative post-ceasefire Palestinian death toll stands at approximately 933+ since October 11, 2025, against a total of 72,939 killed since October 7, 2023.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OCHA, IDF, Gaza Ministry of Health, B'Tselem, ICC, ICJ, Reuters, Al Jazeera, OHCHR, UNRWA, Times of Israel, Haaretz, Bloomberg, Jerusalem Post, Human Rights Watch, Save the Children, Amnesty International, UNICEF, NPR, Middle East Eye, CNN, The National, Euronews, CBC News, NBC News, FDD, WFP, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are subject to ongoing verification. The conflict has persisted since Israeli independence on May 14, 1948.
